about: Every error code EA Explorer gives (Release 7.9, D787). One list: the API, the logs, System Admin health and alerts, eax status and the error guide all read it. Codes are EAX-AREA-NNN; a code never changes meaning.

errors.title: Request not valid
errors.meaning: The API could not take the request as sent.
errors.cause: A value is missing, of the wrong kind or not allowed.
errors.to_do: Read the message: it names the value. Correct it and send again.

errors.title: Not signed in
errors.meaning: The request carried no valid sign-in.
errors.cause: The session ended, or the token or API key is wrong or expired.
errors.to_do: Sign in again. For a machine, check its API key under System Admin > Machine access.

errors.title: Not allowed
errors.meaning: The person or machine is signed in but its roles do not allow this.
errors.cause: A role is missing, or the account is view only.
errors.to_do: Ask a Super Admin to give the role needed (System Admin > Users and roles), or use an account that has it.

errors.title: Not found
errors.meaning: What was asked for is not there, or the person may not see it.
errors.cause: A wrong address or id, something deleted, or no right to read it.
errors.to_do: Check the address and id. If it should be there, check the person's access to its model or project.

errors.title: Method not allowed
errors.meaning: The address does not take this kind of request.
errors.cause: A GET sent where a POST is needed, or the other way round.
errors.to_do: Check the method in the API reference (Documentation > API (Swagger)).

errors.title: Conflict
errors.meaning: The change clashes with what is there now.
errors.cause: Someone changed it first, or the name is already taken.
errors.to_do: Load it again, look at what changed and make the change again.

errors.title: Upload too large
errors.meaning: The upload is bigger than the largest allowed.
errors.cause: The file is over the limit set in System settings.
errors.to_do: Make the file smaller, or raise the largest upload under System Admin > System settings.

errors.title: Values not valid
errors.meaning: The request's values did not pass the checks.
errors.cause: A field is missing or has a value it cannot take.
errors.to_do: Read the message and the errors it lists; correct each field and send again.

errors.title: Needs your yes first
errors.meaning: This would put the maintenance page up, so it asks first.
errors.cause: A restore, update or similar step.
errors.to_do: Accept the warning on the screen, or send the request again with accept_maintenance set to true.

errors.title: Too many requests
errors.meaning: Too many requests came in a short time.
errors.cause: A script or tool calling in a tight loop.
errors.to_do: Wait a minute and slow the caller down.

errors.title: Server error
errors.meaning: Something went wrong inside the API.
errors.cause: A fault in EA Explorer, or a service it needs is not answering.
errors.to_do: Run eax status. Then eax logs api and look for the request id the message gives; report it with that id.

errors.title: Service behind the front door not answering
errors.meaning: The front door could not reach the service behind it.
errors.cause: That container stopped or is starting.
errors.to_do: Run eax status. If a container is not running, run eax up.

errors.title: Not available right now
errors.meaning: The service cannot answer now.
errors.cause: It is starting, stopping or a part it needs is down.
errors.to_do: Wait a minute and try again. If it stays, run eax status.

errors.title: The answer took too long
errors.meaning: The front door gave up waiting.
errors.cause: A slow query or a busy service.
errors.to_do: Try again. If it keeps happening, see System Admin > Health and the tuning guide.

errors.title: A value is not valid
errors.meaning: The database could not take a value as given.
errors.cause: Not an id, not a date, or the wrong kind of value.
errors.to_do: Read the message: it names the value. Correct it and send again.

errors.title: Change refused
errors.meaning: The change cannot be made as asked.
errors.cause: It breaks a rule of the model, the metamodel or the request.
errors.to_do: Read the message: it says which rule. Change the request to keep it.

errors.title: API not answering
errors.meaning: The API container does not answer.
errors.cause: It stopped, is starting, or failed to start.
errors.to_do: Run eax status, then eax logs api. Start it again with eax up.

errors.title: Part switched off
errors.meaning: This part of EA Explorer is switched off in this installation.
errors.cause: A Super Admin switched it off.
errors.to_do: A Super Admin switches it on under System Admin > System settings. Its data is kept.

errors.title: Read only during maintenance
errors.meaning: Nothing can be changed while a restore or an update runs.
errors.cause: A restore or update was started.
errors.to_do: Wait for it to finish (System Admin > Backups shows progress). Reading still works.

errors.title: Read only: DR copy
errors.meaning: This installation is the DR copy of another and takes no changes.
errors.cause: A DR pairing holds.
errors.to_do: Make changes on the main site. To take over, a Super Admin stops the pairing (System Admin > Site pairings).

errors.title: Database down
errors.meaning: The database does not answer.
errors.cause: The db container stopped, is full or is starting.
errors.to_do: Run eax status. If db is not running, run eax up; then eax logs db. Check the disk is not full.

errors.title: Database and API versions differ
errors.meaning: The database's version is not the API's.
errors.cause: An update did not finish, or a backup from another version was restored.
errors.to_do: Run eax up again so the migrations run. See the upgrade guide if it stays.

errors.title: Job runner not working
errors.meaning: Background jobs cannot run.
errors.cause: The job tables are missing or the database is down.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs api. Run eax up to start it again.

errors.title: Jobs waiting too long or failed
errors.meaning: Jobs wait too long, or some failed.
errors.cause: The job runner stopped, or a job hit an error.
errors.to_do: Open System Admin > Jobs: look at the failed or waiting jobs, run again or cancel them.

errors.title: Sign-in down
errors.meaning: Keycloak does not answer, so nobody can sign in.
errors.cause: The keycloak container stopped or is starting.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs keycloak; run eax up. To get in meanwhile, use the break-glass account.

errors.title: Reports down
errors.meaning: Apache Superset does not answer.
errors.cause: The reports container stopped or is starting.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs reports; run eax up.

errors.title: Documents down
errors.meaning: Mayan EDMS does not answer.
errors.cause: The dms container stopped or is starting.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs dms; run eax up.

errors.title: Document queue down
errors.meaning: Valkey, the documents' queue, does not answer or refuses the password.
errors.cause: The dms-broker container stopped, or its password changed.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs dms-broker; run eax up.

errors.title: Diagrams down
errors.meaning: draw.io does not answer.
errors.cause: The drawio container stopped or is starting.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs drawio; run eax up.

errors.title: Library down
errors.meaning: The library service does not answer.
errors.cause: The library container stopped or is starting.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs library; run eax up.

errors.title: Drawn views down
errors.meaning: The views service does not answer.
errors.cause: The views container stopped or is starting.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs views; run eax up.

errors.title: Operations down
errors.meaning: The operations part does not answer or cannot reach its schema.
errors.cause: Its container or the database is down.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs api; run eax up.

errors.title: Operations helper not reachable
errors.meaning: The operations helper (the ops container) does not answer, so containers, restarts, backups, the terminal and alerts cannot be reached from the screens.
errors.cause: Its container is stopped, still starting, or cannot reach Docker.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs ops; run eax up. While EA Explorer starts, wait a minute and look again.

errors.title: Personal data not available
errors.meaning: People's personal data (pins, settings) cannot be read now.
errors.cause: Its service or schema cannot be reached.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs api; run eax up. The rest of EA Explorer still works.

errors.title: Web screens down
errors.meaning: The web container does not answer.
errors.cause: It stopped or is starting.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs web; run eax up.

errors.title: Front door down
errors.meaning: The proxy that every browser goes through does not answer.
errors.cause: The proxy container stopped, or its certificate or settings are wrong.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs proxy; run eax up. Check the certificate files if it will not start.

errors.title: MCP server down
errors.meaning: AI tools cannot reach EA Explorer.
errors.cause: The MCP server inside the api container is not answering.
errors.to_do: Run eax logs api; run eax up. Check EAX_MCP_ENABLED in the config file.

errors.title: Nightly backup switched off
errors.meaning: No backup is made each night.
errors.cause: Someone switched the schedule off.
errors.to_do: Switch it on under System Admin > Backups.

errors.title: Backups folder not mounted
errors.meaning: The API cannot see the backups folder.
errors.cause: The folder in the config file is missing or not shared with Docker.
errors.to_do: Check the backups folder setting in the config file exists, then run eax up.

errors.title: No backup yet
errors.meaning: There is no finished backup to restore from.
errors.cause: None has run yet, or every one failed.
errors.to_do: Run eax backup now, then check eax backups lists it.

errors.title: Newest backup too old
errors.meaning: The newest backup is older than the limit.
errors.cause: The nightly backup failed or did not run.
errors.to_do: Run eax backup now; then look at why the nightly one failed (System Admin > Backups shows each run and why it failed).

errors.title: Break-glass account used
errors.meaning: The emergency account was used and is no longer sealed.
errors.cause: Someone signed in with it.
errors.to_do: Check the audit log for what was done, change EAX_BREAK_GLASS_PASSWORD in the config file and run eax up.

errors.title: Break-glass state unreadable
errors.meaning: The break-glass account's state could not be read.
errors.cause: The database is down or not migrated.
errors.to_do: Run eax status; fix the database first.

errors.title: Disk filling up
errors.meaning: A disk the installation uses is nearly full.
errors.cause: Backups, logs or documents growing.
errors.to_do: Run eax footprint; remove old backups (eax backups) and back up and clean the logs (eax logs backup).

errors.title: Container near its memory limit
errors.meaning: A container is near its memory limit and may be stopped.
errors.cause: Load, or a limit set too low.
errors.to_do: See System Admin > Footprint; raise the container's limit (see the tuning guide) and run eax up.

errors.title: Certificate ending
errors.meaning: The front door's certificate ends soon.
errors.cause: It was not renewed.
errors.to_do: Renew it (System Admin > Secrets: passwords, keys and certificates) or replace the files, then run eax up.

errors.title: Secret needs a person
errors.meaning: A password, key or certificate is due or overdue.
errors.cause: It does not rotate by itself, or its rotation failed.
errors.to_do: Open System Admin > Secrets and rotate the ones listed.

errors.title: Security findings
errors.meaning: The last security gate found high or critical findings.
errors.cause: A dependency or setting with a known weakness.
errors.to_do: Open the last security test run (System Admin > Self-test) and fix or accept each finding.

errors.title: Database connections nearly used up
errors.meaning: The database is near its connection limit.
errors.cause: Too many API servers, or connections left open.
errors.to_do: See System Admin > Databases; lower EAX_API_SERVERS or raise the limit (tuning guide).

errors.title: Long open transaction
errors.meaning: A transaction has been open a long time and can block others.
errors.cause: A stuck job or a session left open.
errors.to_do: See System Admin > Databases; end the session or job holding it.

errors.title: Database maintenance findings
errors.meaning: The last database check found things to fix.
errors.cause: Bloat, missing statistics or similar.
errors.to_do: Open System Admin > Database maintenance and follow each finding.

errors.title: Database integrity findings
errors.meaning: The integrity check found data that is not right.
errors.cause: An interrupted change or a restore.
errors.to_do: Open System Admin > Database maintenance, its integrity check, and repair each finding.

errors.title: Many server errors
errors.meaning: Many calls ended in a server error in the last hour.
errors.cause: A fault or a service down.
errors.to_do: Run eax status; then System Admin > Logs, web log filtered to 5xx, for the calls and their request ids.

errors.title: Self-test failed
errors.meaning: The last self-test had failed checks.
errors.cause: Something is broken, or the test hit a change.
errors.to_do: Open System Admin > Self-test, look at the failed checks and fix them.

errors.title: Jobs stuck
errors.meaning: Background jobs are waiting or running too long.
errors.cause: The job runner stopped or a job hangs.
errors.to_do: Open System Admin > Jobs; cancel the stuck ones and check eax logs api.

errors.title: Discovery overdue
errors.meaning: Discovery projects whose run is overdue.
errors.cause: Their AI has not run them.
errors.to_do: Open AI (MCP) > Enterprise discovery and run them, or change their schedule.

errors.title: A custom check is over its level
errors.meaning: A check an admin added is over its warning or critical level.
errors.cause: Whatever that check measures.
errors.to_do: Open System Admin > Alerts to see the check and its message.

errors.title: Health could not be checked
errors.meaning: The service health could not be read at all.
errors.cause: The API is failing.
errors.to_do: Run eax status and eax logs api.

errors.title: Container not running
errors.meaning: A container EA Explorer needs has stopped.
errors.cause: It failed, was stopped, or ran out of memory.
errors.to_do: Run eax logs <container> to see why; then eax up.

errors.title: Container unhealthy
errors.meaning: A container is running but its own health check fails.
errors.cause: It is starting slowly or cannot reach what it needs.
errors.to_do: Wait a minute; if it stays, run eax logs <container>.

errors.title: Docker not answering
errors.meaning: Docker's engine does not answer.
errors.cause: Docker Desktop is not running.
errors.to_do: Start Docker Desktop, wait until it says it is running, then run eax up.
